payload.message: Reminder: 30-minute WOPR command cycle. You are sending Falken a standing every-30-minute operations update. Do this each run: (1) Review ~/.openclaw/workspace/EXECUTION-QUEUE.md, ~/.openclaw/workspace/WORKFORCE.md, and newest files in ~/.openclaw/workspace/reports. (2) If no meaningful active work is running, choose the highest-leverage next task and execute it immediately (spawn focused coding/research subagents when helpful). (3) Integrate results into artifacts in workspace. (4) Send Falken a concise status update with exactly these sections: DONE, IN PROGRESS, NEXT, BLOCKERS. If there are no blockers, write 'BLOCKERS: none'. Never reply NO_REPLY for this reminder; always provide the update.

payload.text: Reminder: send Falken a concise status update in #workspace (what was completed, what is in progress, blockers/next action). This is the 10-minute check-in cadence Falken requested.
